visualCharacteristics.purpose: inline image preview with a zoom icon that opens all slides in a modal carousel
traits: first slide shown inline (full width, half width from 768px) with a round photo-gallery icon centred on it (bottom right for a single slide)
lightbox on a 90% black backdrop: close icon top right, image at full width, dark arrow tabs on the image edges, "1 of 2" counter (Slide label) below the image
Escape, backdrop click or close button closes; focus returns to the preview
arrow keys navigate; a single slide shows no arrows or counter

contentPattern.structure: One row per slide. Cell 1: image (required, with alt text; rows without an image are not slides). Cell 2 (optional): caption shown under the image in the lightbox. The first slide's image is the inline preview button. Optional label rows (2 cells, no image) for UI strings, with defaults by page language: Open label (EN 'Enlarge image', DE 'Bild vergrößern'), Close label ('Close' / 'Schließen'), Previous label ('Previous image' / 'Vorheriges Bild'), Next label ('Next image' / 'Nächstes Bild'), Dialog label ('Image gallery' / 'Bildergalerie'), Slide label ('{n} of {total}' / '{n} von {total}'; also the visible counter under the image). Optional intro row(s) before the first slide (1 cell, no image, not a label row): headings and text shown above the preview, in the preview's column (half width from 768px). Rows without an image after the first slide are ignored; a block without any image is hidden

reuseGuidance: Use when one image preview should open a set of large images in a modal. For several teasers visible inline use carousel-cards.
